why: Every number README.md publishes between the canonical-bench markers, held as data so tools/check_canonical_benchmarks.py can detect drift. Re-measuring the canonical host needs that host; noticing that a published number changed does not. Editing a figure in README.md without editing it here fails the gate, and so does adding one that cites no source.

canonical-bench-host.description: Intel Xeon (family 6, model 207, Emerald Rapids) @ 2.10 GHz, 4 vCPU KVM guest; AVX-512F/VL/BW/DQ/VBMI/IFMA + VAES + VPCLMULQDQ + SHA-NI + BMI2/ADX; Linux 6.18.44; gcc 13.3.0, CMake Release, -DAMA_USE_NATIVE_PQC=ON; Python 3.11.15 with the native library and all six Cython bindings built by `python setup.py build_ext --inplace` at 974cb019. The 4.x figures this source replaces (measured 2026-04-25 to 2026-04-27 on an AVX-512 VBMI+VAES+VPCLMULQDQ VM) are kept in docs/BENCHMARK_HISTORY.md.
canonical-bench-host.measured: 2026-09-24, five interleaved rounds, each process pinned with taskset -c 0; published figure = median of five, ranges = min-max
canonical-bench-host.command: python benchmarks/benchmark_runner.py --output <round>.json; build/bin/benchmark_c_raw --json; the X25519 pair via ama_x25519_set_mulx_override(0/1) around benchmark_runner.run_x25519_benchmark

sandbox-host.description: The secp256k1 fixed-base comb measurement host, raw C, reported alongside the Welch t-test in docs/BENCHMARK_HISTORY.md.

comb-table-size.description: Not a measurement of a machine: the 4-block fixed-base comb table is a compile-time constant, 16 entries, sized from the generator table in src/c/ama_secp256k1.c.
comb-table-size.command: sizeof the comb table in src/c/ama_secp256k1.c

literature.description: Reported by OpenSSL (crypto/ec/asm/x25519-x86_64.pl) and BoringSSL (fiat-crypto MULX/ADX), not measured by this repository. Recorded so the citation cannot drift into reading as an AMA measurement (INVARIANT-36).

cited-specification.description: Not a measurement: a number the region prints because a specification defines it — the FIPS 203/204 and RFC 3161/8032 document numbers, the ML-DSA modulus q = 8380417 (FIPS 204 Table 1), the CPUID.(EAX=7,ECX=0):EBX bit indices of BMI2 (8) and ADX (19) (Intel SDM Vol. 2A, CPUID), and dudect's |t| decision threshold of 4.5. Pinned so that every number in the region is accounted for.
cited-specification.measured: n/a - defined by the cited specification, not measured

source-constant.description: Not a measurement of a machine: a count fixed by this repository's code — the 4096 random vectors of tests/c/test_x25519_fe64_mulx_equiv.c, the 1024 of tests/c/test_x25519_field_equiv.c, and the 10-versus-16 multiplication count of fe64_sq512_mulx against the full schoolbook in src/c/internal/ama_x25519_fe64_mulx.c.
source-constant.measured: n/a - a compile-time property of the tree
source-constant.command: read from the named source files
